tools.description: Connection, entry points and capability information. Report only host capabilities the client actually has.

rubric: The agent says plainly that this client has no filesystem it can write, so it cannot persist preferences across sessions and will not claim to remember them.

It still delivers the value: an exportable preference record (the template filled with the supplied values, unknowns left unset) that the user can save themselves, with the path convention to put it under when a workspace exists.
It explains how the record is used next time (paste it or point INTGRAL_WORKSPACE at a directory containing it) without promising anything the host cannot do.
No unnecessary questions; no tool writes; nothing created anywhere.
